summary.text: Mack Butler, a Republican, has represented District 28 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he earned an associate degree in electrical engineering technologies from Gadsden State Community College in 1984 and owns Butler Electrical Contractors, LLC.
He has served as chairman of the Etowah County Republican Party board and as president of the Etowah County Board of Education.
